Elaine: Heads-up: final SEO pass for the LLM webinar + launch post. Need redirects, schema, internal linking from resources hub, and benchmark narrative alignment. Launch Wed.
Priya: On it Will run a full crawl and export CSV of affected URLs. ETA Mon noon.
Sam: I can own H1/H2/meta and the on-page anchor plan. Which core phrases are we prioritizing?
Elaine: Core keywords: "LLM inference latency", "production LLM serving", "reduce inference cost". Add long-tail intent: "end-to-end inference cost optimization" and "LLM serving at scale best practices".
Jackson: I'll build JSON-LD for Event + VideoObject + FAQ. Need embargo lift time and recording URL so I can fill in post-launch.
Priya: Crawl notes: spotted 7 legacy demo paths under /beta/demo that redirect to /demos via a chain (beta -> old-demo -> demos). Will propose fixes. Also 52 pages missing canonical tags.
Sam: Small on-page guidance: keep H1 tight, use long-tail in H2s, include 1 internal link to /benchmarks and 2 contextual links from resources hub. Meta desc should include primary keyword + CTA.
Priya: Proposed nginx redirect (param-preserving):
```
rewrite ^/beta/demo/(.*)$ /demos/$1?$args permanent;
```
Also flag: avoid multi-hop redirects; prefer single 301.
SEO_Bot: Quick crawl summary: 52 missing canonicals, 9 redirect chains, 4 pages disallowed by robots.txt. Report id: cr-2026-04-13-llm.
Jackson: JSON-LD template (will drop into page head, replace placeholders post-PR):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Scaling LLM Inference: Live Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-28T17:00:00Z",
  "location": "Online",
  "description": "Live webinar with Redwood Inference: production tips, benchmark narratives on latency and cost.",
  "performer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" },
  "workExample": { "@type": "VideoObject", "name": "Webinar Recording", "uploadDate": "2026-04-28" }
}
```
Priya: Deliverables: redirect CSV + cleaned rewrite rules PR, canonical audit spreadsheet. I'll tag high-risk dupes in the sheet.
Sam: I'll submit the content edits PR with H1/H2/meta and link suggestions by Tue EOD.
Elaine: Plan: if all PRs land by Tue EOD we can proceed with Wed launch. If Priya uncovers any chains we can't fix, we'll add canonical hints temporarily and run a rollback test. Ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
